items.title: Optimization and Initialization
items.instruction_text: Use the official UvA Deep Learning tutorial on Optimization and Initialization and extract one contiguous notebook segment involving optimizer behavior, initialization choices, or their empirical effects on training.
learning_objectives: Understand how optimization and initialization affect training dynamics.
Analyze training behavior under different design choices.
Interpret empirical results from notebook-based experiments.
items.course_context: UvA Deep Learning Tutorials / Tutorial 4: Optimization and Initialization
items.notes: Candidate record. The official UvA tutorial repository explicitly lists 'Tutorial 4: Optimization and Initialization'. This is a good source for structured optimization-focused expert tasks.

items.title: Vision Transformers
items.instruction_text: Use the official UvA Deep Learning tutorial on Vision Transformers and extract one contiguous implementation or analysis task involving Transformer-based image classification.
learning_objectives: Relate patch-based representations to downstream classification.
Implement or analyze a ViT-style workflow in practice.
items.course_context: UvA Deep Learning Tutorials / Tutorial 15: Vision Transformers
items.notes: Candidate record. The official UvA tutorial repository explicitly lists 'Tutorial 15: Vision Transformers'. This is a good high-level Transformer source if you want more than pure NLP tasks.
